command: pnpm exec vitest run --config work/performance-vitest.config.ts --reporter verbose
functional_sanity: Distinct account balances are supplied as 2000, 2017, ... major units for each case.
Each plan case produces at least one debt-minimum event per synthetic debt and pending obligation count equals debt count.

Each history case exercises buildTimelineRows, buildDecisionHistoryRows, and selectDebtTrackingPresentation; each produces one timeline and one decision row per transaction plus each synthetic debt event, with eight active tracked debts.
History records are synthetic projections only; no device, database, backend, or live history was used.
limitations: These history cases measure existing buildTimelineRows/buildDecisionHistoryRows/selectDebtTrackingPresentation derivation with synthetic transaction and debt-event records; they do not measure the physical device or persisted SQLite history.
No performance acceptance threshold is introduced.
The scaleEstimates_separate field is output from estimateScaleBenchmark and is not part of measured timings.
